- Example line, an intraday cancel: {"VALUE_TYPE":"PV","GRAIN":"TRADE","TRADE_ID":"1000414","CURRENCY":"USD","SOURCE_SYSTEM":"ENDUR","SCENARIO_PV_ID":"SPV-1000414-HS-509-I-2026-09-30-001","SECURITY_ID":null,"INSTRUMENT":"ENGY-SWAP USD 2026-11","BUSINESS_DATE":"2026-09-30","SCENARIO_SET_ID":"HS-509","TRADE_VERSIONS":"v8","TRADE_STATUS":"CANCELLED","MATURITY_DATE":"2026-11-30","LEGAL_ENTITY":"LE-NY","DIVISION":"DIV-MARKETS","DESK":"DESK-COMM","TT_BOOK":"BOOK-COMM-1","LIMIT_LETTER":"LL-0001","PORTFOLIO":"BOOK-COMM-1","STRATEGY":"","PRODUCT_GROUP":"Commodity","PRODUCT_TYPE":"ComSwap","COUNTERPARTY":"CP-NORTHPLAINS","DIRECTION":"LONG","QUANTITY":96000.0,"TAGS":"","BASE_PV":581788.0,"VALUATION_DATE":"2026-09-30","BASE_VALUATION_DATE":"2026-09-30","SCENARIO_PV":null,"STATUS":"ok","PRICER":"demo-factor-model","MODEL_VERSION":"demo-2","COMPUTED_AT":"2026-09-30T06:05:04Z","BATCH_ID":"I-2026-09-30-001","RESTATEMENT":0,"RUN_KIND":"INTRADAY"}
- The other form's lines (the pnl-vector contract): a trade's P&L vector, a position's; both forms may come from one pricing system on different days, never on one date (DRS-5210).
- The engine (VarIntake) rejects a row, counted and listed in every answer's provenance, never padded: a null or NaN in SCENARIO_PV (DRS-5206, the scenarios named: a scenario that failed to price is never filled with zero), a currency with no scenario FX on the date (DRS-5207), a length other than the scenario set's, no BASE_PV, or a VALUATION_DATE or BASE_VALUATION_DATE that differs from the other or from the business date (DRS-5201).
- FX: each currency's scenario rates from fx-scenario when the batch supplies them, else derived from the FX history of fx-spot (today's rate moved by each scenario day's 1-day move); every cross goes through USD.
- The same one-run checks as pnl-vector: one BATCH_ID and the date's SCENARIO_SET_ID across both kinds; a TRADE_ID in both refuses the date (DRS-5202).
- 1.1: SCENARIO_PV is required on every row except an intraday cancel (TRADE_STATUS CANCELLED) or a failed row (STATUS failed), where it is null; TRADE_STATUS may be CANCELLED.

### FXS: Scenario FX of a currency (509 scenarios) (`fx-scenario`)

A currency's rate against USD today and under each historical scenario, as the risk batch supplies it (2.9.4; VAR_GUIDE.md section 15.9): the VaR engine converts scenario PVs and reporting currencies with it. A currency the batch does not supply is derived from the FX history (fx-spot).

**Class** input · **Key** `FX_SCENARIO_ID` · **Dated by** `BUSINESS_DATE` · **Cadence** daily · **Stored by** connector `risk-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/risk/fx-scenario/` · **Ids** `^FXS-`.

**Grain:** One row per currency, business date and scenario set (BUSINESS_DATE), keyed by FX_SCENARIO_ID (FXS-<CURRENCY>-<SCENARIO_SET_ID>). **Contract:** `contracts/fx-scenario.contract.yaml` ([full contract page](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/market-risk.md#fxs-scenario-fx-of-a-currency-509-scenarios-fx-scenario)).

| Column | Type | Key | Presence | Unit | Example or values | Link | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FX_SCENARIO_ID` | id | key | required |  | `FXS-EUR-HS-509` (pattern `^FXS-`) |  | The record's id (the business key) |
| `BUSINESS_DATE` | date |  | required |  | `2026-09-30` |  | The close of business the rates belong to (YYYY-MM-DD): the date of the scenario PVs they convert. |
| `SCENARIO_SET_ID` | id |  | required |  | `HS-509` |  | The scenario set whose SCENARIO_DATES order RATES; it must be the date's set (one set per date, DRS-5203). |
| `CURRENCY` | text |  | required |  | `EUR` |  | The currency the rates are for (ISO code). |
| `QUOTE` | text |  | required |  | `USD per 1 EUR` |  | How the rates are quoted, in words: always USD per one unit of CURRENCY ("USD per 1 EUR"). |
| `RATE` | rate |  | required | USD per unit | `1.174` |  | USD per one unit of the currency on the business date. |
| `RATES` | vector |  | required | USD per unit |  |  | USD per one unit of the currency under each scenario, oldest first: index i is the scenario set's day i. Every cross rate goes through USD. *509 values in the test data* |
| `SOURCE` | text |  | required |  | `demo-factor-model` |  | The system or model that produced the rates (the demo's synthetic factor model). |
| `BATCH_ID` | id |  | required |  | `B-2026-09-30-01` |  | The risk batch that produced the rates, the same run as the date's scenario PVs and P&L vectors (one batch per date, DRS-5203). |

- Delivery format (product owner, 2026-10-27): JSONL: one JSON object per line, UTF-8, one row of this contract a line, exactly its fields (no other); a file is .jsonl, or .jsonl.gz. This is the contract a pricing system sends; tools/pvgen writes it (docs/guides/VAR_GUIDE.md section 15.12). The vector of the examples below is cut to its first 3 values: a row carries all 509.
- Example line, one currency's rates: {"FX_SCENARIO_ID":"FXS-AUD-HS-509","BUSINESS_DATE":"2026-09-30","SCENARIO_SET_ID":"HS-509","CURRENCY":"AUD","QUOTE":"USD per 1 AUD","RATE":0.661,"RATES":[0.6636463229,0.6635844635,0.6613830351],"SOURCE":"demo-factor-model","BATCH_ID":"B-2026-09-30-01"}
- Always USD per one unit of CURRENCY (RATE today, RATES under each scenario, in the scenario set's order); USD itself is never sent. Every cross rate goes through USD: units of B per unit of A are rate(A) / rate(B).
- A rate that is not a positive number, or RATES of another length than the scenario set's, leaves the currency out of the date (the engine says so: a trade priced in it is rejected, DRS-5207; the currency cannot be asked as a reporting currency).

### SSET: Scenario set (`scenario-set`)

The historical scenario days of a business date, oldest first: index i of every P&L vector, scenario-PV vector and FX scenario of the date is SCENARIO_DATES[i].

**Class** input · **Key** `SCENARIO_SET_ID` · **Dated by** `BUSINESS_DATE` · **Cadence** daily · **Stored by** connector `risk-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/risk/scenario-set/` · **Ids** `^HS-`.

**Grain:** One row per scenario set per BUSINESS_DATE, keyed by SCENARIO_SET_ID. **Contract:** `contracts/scenario-set.contract.yaml` ([full contract page](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/market-risk.md#sset-scenario-set-scenario-set)).

| Column | Type | Key | Presence | Unit | Example or values | Link | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SCENARIO_SET_ID` | id | key | required |  | `HS-509` (pattern `^HS-`) |  | The record's id (the business key) |
| `BUSINESS_DATE` | date |  | required |  | `2026-09-30` |  | The close of business whose vectors the set orders (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `SCENARIO_DATES` | date list |  | required |  |  |  | The historical days whose moves make the scenarios, oldest first: position i of every P&L vector is day i. |
| `SCENARIO_COUNT` | integer |  | required |  | `509` |  | N, the number of scenario days: the length of SCENARIO_DATES and of every vector of the date. |
| `WINDOW_START` | date |  | required |  | `2024-09-17` |  | The oldest scenario day. |
| `WINDOW_END` | date |  | required |  | `2026-09-29` |  | The newest scenario day: the business day before the business date. |
| `HORIZON_DAYS` | integer |  | required |  | `1` |  | The holding period of the scenario moves, in business days (1). |
| `REVALUATION` | text |  | required |  | `full` |  | full (every trade repriced under each scenario) or sensitivities (a Taylor expansion), as the batch did it. |
| `WEIGHTS` | unknown |  | optional |  |  |  | Age weights for a weighted method, one per scenario in SCENARIO_DATES order; null for equal weights (not used by the engine). |
| `SOURCE_BATCH` | text |  | required |  | `B-2026-09-30-01` |  | The risk batch that produced the set and its vectors (the date's BATCH_ID). |
| `DESCRIPTION` | text |  | required |  | `Historical simulation, 509 business days, equal weights` |  | A description of the set in words. |

### HIER: Risk hierarchy node (`risk-hierarchy`)

One node of a VaR hierarchy (MGMT or LEGAL): its level, parent, children, the books under it and its VaR limit.

**Class** input · **Key** `NODE_ID` · **Dated by** `BUSINESS_DATE` · **Cadence** daily · **Stored by** connector `risk-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/risk/risk-hierarchy/` · **Ids** `^(MGMT|LEGAL)~`.

**Grain:** One row per risk hierarchy node per BUSINESS_DATE, keyed by NODE_ID. **Contract:** `contracts/risk-hierarchy.contract.yaml` ([full contract page](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/market-risk.md#hier-risk-hierarchy-node-risk-hierarchy)).

| Column | Type | Key | Presence | Unit | Example or values | Link | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NODE_ID` | id | key | required |  | `LEGAL~LE-NY` (pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*~`) | `risk-hierarchy` | The record's id (the business key) |
| `HIERARCHY` | text |  | required |  | `LEGAL` (pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`) |  | The hierarchy's id (2.9.5: any name, A-Z, digits, _). The demo's: MGMT (bank, division, desk, book) and LEGAL (bank, legal entity, desk, book); a book is in one leaf of each. A hierarchy may instead be built from the trades' columns (VAR_GUIDE.md section 16): its rows here are then not read. |
| `LEVEL` | text |  | required |  | `legal-entity` |  | The node's level, a name of the hierarchy's own (2.9.5): bank, division, legal-entity, desk or book in the demo. |
| `PARENT_ID` | id |  | optional |  | `LEGAL~BANK` |  | The parent node's NODE_ID (null at the root); the engine builds the tree from it. |
| `NAME` | text |  | required |  | `LE-NY` |  | The node's display name. |
| `REF` | record |  | optional |  |  |  | The master record the node stands for, one object: KIND (legal-entity, desk, book) and ID (LE-…, DESK-…, BOOK-…); null for the bank and division nodes. |
| `CHILDREN` | text list |  | required |  |  |  | The child nodes' ids; informational, the engine uses PARENT_ID. |
| `BOOKS` | text list |  | required |  |  |  | Every book beneath the node: its positions are the node's. |
| `BUSINESS_DATE` | date |  | required |  | `2026-09-30` |  | The close of business the node belongs to (YYYY-MM-DD): a past date's VaR uses that date's hierarchy. |
| `VALID_FROM` | date |  | required |  | `2026-01-02` |  | The first date the node is valid (YYYY-MM-DD). Informational. |
| `VALID_TO` | unknown |  | optional |  |  |  | The last date the node is valid (YYYY-MM-DD); null while it is open-ended. Informational. |

Nested `REF`:

| Column | Type | Key | Presence | Unit | Example or values | Link | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `KIND` | text |  | required |  | `book`, `desk`, `legal-entity` |  | The kind of master record the node is (legal-entity, desk, book). |
| `ID` | id |  | required |  | `LE-NY` |  | The id of the master record the node is (a legal entity, desk or book id). |

**Links:** `NODE_ID` → `risk-hierarchy`.

### VLIM: VaR limit of a hierarchy node (`var-limit`)

The 1-day 99% VaR limit of one node of a hierarchy, keyed by the hierarchy and the node's id, in USD

**Class** input · **Key** `LIMIT_ID` · **Dated by** `BUSINESS_DATE` · **Cadence** daily · **Stored by** connector `risk-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/risk/var-limit/` · **Ids** `^VL-`.

**Grain:** One row per hierarchy node with a limit per BUSINESS_DATE, keyed by LIMIT_ID (VL-<NODE_ID>). **Contract:** `contracts/var-limit.contract.yaml` ([full contract page](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/market-risk.md#vlim-var-limit-of-a-hierarchy-node-var-limit)).

| Column | Type | Key | Presence | Unit | Example or values | Link | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LIMIT_ID` | id | key | required |  | `VL-LL~LL-0003` (pattern `^VL-`) |  | The record's id, VL-<NODE_ID> (the business key) |
| `HIERARCHY` | text |  | required |  | `LL` (pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`) |  | The hierarchy the node is in (A-Z, digits, _): LL, MGMT, LEGAL in the demo, read for a hierarchy whose configuration names this kind (limits: var-limit, VAR_GUIDE.md section 16); PORTFOLIO for a portfolio's limit (NODE_ID its PORTFOLIO_ID). Every VaR limit lives here, with its currency (2.9.7, decision 8): the risk-hierarchy rows and the portfolios carry none. |
| `NODE_ID` | id |  | required |  | `LL~LL-0003/DESK-RATES` (pattern `^([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*~\|PF-)`) | `risk-hierarchy` | The node: its id as the engine builds it (LL~LL-0003, LL~LL-0003/DESK-RATES; MGMT~DESK-RATES), or a portfolio's id (PF-RATES-DESK) on a row of hierarchy PORTFOLIO (2.9.7). A row that names no node of the date is unused and said (DRS-5212). A node without a row has no limit (shown blank, never zero). |
| `LIMIT_VAR` | amount |  | required | USD | `8500000` |  | The 1-day 99% VaR the node may take, in USD (shown in another reporting currency at today's rate). It wins over a risk-hierarchy row's own LIMIT_VAR for the same node. |
| `CURRENCY` | text |  | required |  | `USD` |  | The currency of LIMIT_VAR, ISO 4217: USD. |
| `BUSINESS_DATE` | date |  | required |  | `2026-09-30` |  | The close of business the limit applies to (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `VALID_FROM` | date |  | required |  | `2026-01-02` |  | The first date the limit is valid (YYYY-MM-DD). Informational. |
| `VALID_TO` | date |  | optional |  |  |  | The last date the limit is valid (YYYY-MM-DD); null while it is open-ended. Informational. |

**Links:** `NODE_ID` → `risk-hierarchy`.

- JSON Lines, one row per line (UTF-8). Example line: {"LIMIT_ID":"VL-LL~LL-0003","HIERARCHY":"LL","NODE_ID":"LL~LL-0003","LIMIT_VAR":4100000,"CURRENCY":"USD","BUSINESS_DATE":"2026-09-30","VALID_FROM":"2026-01-02","VALID_TO":null}

### VRES: VaR of a scope (computed) (`var-result`)

The VaR, ES, decomposition, worst scenarios and P&L vector of any scope (the scope grammar of VAR_GUIDE.md section 5), computed when asked by the server's VaR engine as the person asking; never stored.

**Class** computed · **Key** — · **Dated by** `on request` · **Cadence** on change · **Stored by** connector `var-engine` (plugin `reactive`).

**Grain:** One answer per question (the scope asked for and the business date), computed when asked. **Contract:** `contracts/var-result.contract.yaml` ([full contract page](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/market-risk.md#vres-var-of-a-scope-computed-var-result)).

| Column | Type | Key | Presence | Unit | Example or values | Link | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SCOPE` | text |  | required |  | `DESK:RATES` |  | The scope as asked (the id; a ~ inside a node id is written %7E). |
| `CANONICAL` | text |  | required |  |  |  | The scope's canonical text (VAR_GUIDE.md section 5.2). |
| `SCOPE_KIND` | text |  | required |  | `node`, `position`, `trade`, `portfolio`, `basket`, `capture`, `rule`, `counterparty`, `legal-entity`, `adhoc` |  | What kind of scope was asked for (node, position, trade, portfolio, basket, capture, rule, counterparty, legal-entity, adhoc). |
| `LABEL` | text |  | required |  |  |  | The scope's display label. |
| `NODE` | id |  | optional |  |  |  | The hierarchy node when the scope is exactly one node. |
| `BUSINESS_DATE` | date |  | required |  |  |  | The business date answered (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `CURRENCY` | text |  | required |  | `USD` |  | The reporting currency of every amount of the answer (2.9.4): the parameter ccy, USD by default (VRES DESK:RATES~ccy=EUR); VAR_GUIDE.md section 15.10. |
| `VAR` | amount |  | required | CURRENCY |  |  | VaR at CONFIDENCE, positive for a loss (VAR_GUIDE.md section 18.1). |
| `ES` | amount |  | required | CURRENCY |  |  | Expected shortfall at ES_CONFIDENCE (VAR_GUIDE.md section 18.2). |
| `CONFIDENCE` | rate |  | required |  | `0.99` |  | The VaR confidence level, as a fraction (0.99). |
| `ES_CONFIDENCE` | rate |  | required |  | `0.975` |  | The expected shortfall confidence level, as a fraction (0.975). |
| `K` | integer |  | required |  |  |  | The VaR rank (the 6th worst of 509 at 99%). |
| `ES_COUNT` | integer |  | required |  |  |  | The number of worst scenarios averaged into the ES. |
| `SCENARIOS` | integer |  | required |  |  |  | The number of scenarios in the scope's P&L vector (the scenario set's SCENARIO_COUNT). |
| `LIMIT` | amount |  | optional | CURRENCY |  |  | The scope's VaR limit (a node's or portfolio's), converted to the answer's currency; null when it has none. |
| `LIMIT_USE` | rate |  | optional |  |  |  | VAR / LIMIT, as a fraction; null without a limit. |
| `SUM_STANDALONE` | amount |  | optional | CURRENCY |  |  | The sum of the standalone VaRs of the scope's children; null when it has none. |
| `DIVERSIFICATION` | amount |  | optional | CURRENCY |  |  | SUM_STANDALONE minus VAR: what the children's offsets save; null when there are no children. |
| `BACKTEST` | record |  | required |  |  |  | DAYS, EXCEPTIONS, LIGHT, KUPIEC_LR, KUPIEC_P_VALUE, CHRISTOFFERSEN_LR, CHRISTOFFERSEN_P_VALUE (VAR_GUIDE.md section 18.4). |
| `CHILDREN` | record list |  | required |  |  |  | The default parts (VAR_GUIDE.md section 11.3) with KEY, SCOPE, LABEL, KIND, STANDALONE_VAR, COMPONENT_VAR, COMPONENT_ES, INCREMENTAL_VAR, PCT. |
| `WORST` | record list |  | required |  |  |  | The 25 worst scenarios (RANK, INDEX, DATE, PNL). |
| `PNL` | vector |  | required | CURRENCY |  |  | The scope's P&L under each scenario day, oldest first (unrounded). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record |  | required |  |  |  | The headline's provenance in UPPER_SNAKE (VAR_GUIDE.md section 11.2), with TIER saying where the vector came from. |

- No stored key: an answer's id is the scope asked (the id in the request); VAR <scope> <GO> opens the same answer in the explorer.
- Computed as the viewer with the explorer's entitlements (VAR_GUIDE.md section 9); cached per view signature, data version and scope.

### VWIF: VaR what-if (computed, Python) (`var-whatif`)

A scope's VaR and ES before and after hypothetical trades kept in the person's private sandbox, and its stressed window, computed when asked by the Python VaR engine from the scope's var-result; never stored.

**Class** computed · **Key** — · **Dated by** `on request` · **Cadence** on change · **Stored by** connector `var-whatif` (plugin `reactive`).

**Grain:** One answer per question (the scope, the sandbox and the parameters, the business date), computed when asked. **Contract:** `contracts/var-whatif.contract.yaml` ([full contract page](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/market-risk.md#vwif-var-what-if-computed-python-var-whatif)).

| Column | Type | Key | Presence | Unit | Example or values | Link | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SCOPE` | text |  | required |  |  |  | The base scope (the id), e.g. DESK:RATES - TRD:X to take a trade out exactly. |
| `CANONICAL` | text |  | required |  |  |  | The base scope in its canonical form. |
| `BUSINESS_DATE` | date |  | required |  |  |  | The business date answered (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `CURRENCY` | text |  | required |  | `USD` |  | The reporting currency of every amount (2.9.4): the parameter ccy, USD by default; the scope's var-result is read in it. |
| `ITEMS` | integer |  | required |  |  |  | The hypothetical trades of the sandbox (0 without one). |
| `BEFORE_VAR` | amount |  | required | CURRENCY |  |  | The scope's VaR before the hypothetical trades. |
| `AFTER_VAR` | amount |  | required | CURRENCY |  |  | The scope's VaR with the hypothetical trades added. |
| `CHANGE_VAR` | amount |  | required | CURRENCY |  |  | AFTER_VAR minus BEFORE_VAR. |
| `BEFORE_ES` | amount |  | required | CURRENCY |  |  | The scope's expected shortfall before the hypothetical trades. |
| `AFTER_ES` | amount |  | required | CURRENCY |  |  | The scope's expected shortfall with the hypothetical trades added. |
| `CHANGE_ES` | amount |  | required | CURRENCY |  |  | AFTER_ES minus BEFORE_ES. |
| `LIMIT` | amount |  | optional | CURRENCY |  |  | The base scope's VaR limit; null when it has none. |
| `LIMIT_USE_BEFORE` | rate |  | optional |  |  |  | BEFORE_VAR / LIMIT, as a fraction; null without a limit. |
| `LIMIT_USE_AFTER` | rate |  | optional |  |  |  | AFTER_VAR / LIMIT, as a fraction; null without a limit. |
| `CONFIDENCE` | rate |  | required |  |  |  | The base's VaR confidence level, as a fraction. |
| `ES_CONFIDENCE` | rate |  | required |  |  |  | The base's expected shortfall confidence level, as a fraction. |
| `STRESS_WINDOW` | integer |  | required |  |  |  | Scenario days of the stressed window (0 when not asked). |
| `STRESSED_VAR_BEFORE` | amount |  | optional | CURRENCY |  |  | The largest VaR over every run of STRESS_WINDOW consecutive scenario days, before the what-if. |
| `STRESSED_VAR_AFTER` | amount |  | optional | CURRENCY |  |  | The largest VaR, after the trades, over every run of STRESS_WINDOW consecutive scenario days; null when the stress window is 0. |
| `STRESSED_FROM` | integer |  | optional |  |  |  | The index of the stressed window's first scenario day. |

**Links:** `SCOPE` → `var-result`.

- No stored key: an answer's id is the base scope (the id in the request); the parameters ride on it (sandbox, stress-window, component-window).
- The hypothetical trades' vectors are supplied in the sandbox (one P&L per scenario day, priced elsewhere); taking trades out is the scope's own algebra. Pricing through QLRisk is parked until its API is stable.
- The tables items (each trade's standalone, incremental in order and alone, component VaR and ES) and pnl (DAY, BEFORE, AFTER) come with the answer.

### VOFF: VaR official results (published) (`var-official`)

The official end-of-day VaR and ES of every node of the MGMT and LEGAL hierarchies, as the server captured and published them (one row per node, business date and result version); read only, for BI and other readers, never an engine's input.

**Class** computed · **Key** `NODE_ID`, `RESULT_VERSION` · **Dated by** `BUSINESS_DATE` · **Cadence** daily · **Stored by** connector `var-results` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/risk-results/var-official/`.

**Grain:** One row per hierarchy node per BUSINESS_DATE and RESULT_VERSION, keyed by NODE_ID and RESULT_VERSION; the latest version of a date is the date's figure. **Contract:** `contracts/var-official.contract.yaml` ([full contract page](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/market-risk.md#voff-var-official-results-published-var-official)).

| Column | Type | Key | Presence | Unit | Example or values | Link | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BUSINESS_DATE` | date |  | required |  |  |  | The business date (the partition column business_date). |
| `HIERARCHY` | text |  | required |  | `MGMT`, `LEGAL` |  | The hierarchy of the node (MGMT or LEGAL). |
| `NODE_ID` | id | key | required |  | `MGMT~DESK-RATES` | `risk-hierarchy` | The node, <HIERARCHY>~<id>, as in risk-hierarchy. |
| `NODE_NAME` | text |  | required |  |  |  | The node's display name. |
| `PARENT_ID` | id |  | optional |  |  |  | The parent node (none for the bank). |
| `LEVEL` | text |  | required |  | `bank`, `legal-entity`, `division`, `desk`, `book` |  | The node's level in its hierarchy (bank, division, legal-entity, desk, book). |
| `CAPTURE_ID` | id |  | required |  |  |  | The official capture the row was written from (VAR CAPTURE <id> opens it). |
| `RESULT_VERSION` | integer | key | required |  |  |  | 1, then 2, 3 ... on a restatement. |
| `INPUT_VERSIONS` | text |  | required |  |  |  | The inputs' versions, batch ids and position rules' digest, as JSON text. |
| `COMPUTED_AT` | timestamp |  | required |  |  |  | When the official capture computed the row, ISO-8601 UTC. |
| `CONTRACT_VERSION` | text |  | required |  | `1.3` |  | The version of the published table's contract the row carries. |
| `VAR` | amount |  | required | USD |  |  | VaR at CONFIDENCE, positive for a loss. Not additive across nodes. |
| `ES` | amount |  | required | USD |  |  | Expected shortfall at ES_CONFIDENCE, positive for a loss. Not additive across nodes. |
| `CONFIDENCE` | rate |  | required |  | `0.99` |  | The VaR confidence level, as a fraction (0.99). |
| `ES_CONFIDENCE` | rate |  | required |  | `0.975` |  | The expected shortfall confidence level, as a fraction (0.975). |
| `SCENARIO_SET_ID` | id |  | required |  | `HS-509` |  | The scenario set the date's vectors were valued over (HS-509). |
| `SCENARIO_WINDOW` | integer |  | optional |  | `509` |  | The scenarios the record was computed on (2.9.4): the newest N of the scenario set (drishti.var.scenario-window; the set's length, 509 in the demo, for all). Records captured before a change keep theirs; older records lack it. |
| `STANDALONE_SUM` | amount |  | optional | USD |  |  | The sum of the children's VaR (positions for a book). |
| `DIVERSIFICATION` | amount |  | optional | USD |  |  | STANDALONE_SUM minus VAR. |
| `HYPO_PNL` | amount |  | optional | USD |  |  | The node's hypothetical P&L for the date (the backtest's input). |
| `LIMIT` | amount |  | optional | USD |  |  | The node's VaR limit from the hierarchy. |
| `LIMIT_USE` | rate |  | optional |  |  |  | VAR / LIMIT. |
| `TRADE_COUNT` | integer |  | required |  |  |  | The number of trades counted in the node. |
| `POSITION_COUNT` | integer |  | required |  |  |  | The number of positions counted in the node. |
| `EXCEPTIONS_250` | integer |  | optional |  |  |  | Backtest exceptions over the official history (up to 250 days). |
| `TRAFFIC_LIGHT` | text |  | optional |  | `green`, `amber`, `red` |  | The Basel backtest zone over the official history: green up to 4 exceptions in 250 days, amber 5 to 9, red 10 or more. |

**Links:** `NODE_ID` → `risk-hierarchy`.

- Append only (delta.appendOnly), 7 years of log and removed files: a restated date adds rows with the next RESULT_VERSION; nothing is overwritten. The BI model market-risk-var keeps the latest version of each node and date.
- No engine reads it: the only connector over risk-results is this read-only one (tools/test_contracts.py).
- The id is <NODE_ID>@<date>#v<RESULT_VERSION>; VAR NODE:<NODE_ID> opens the explorer at the node.

### SSPNL: Stress P&L of a scenario across desks (derived from the stress results) (`stress-scenario-pnl`)

The bank's stress P&L under one scenario: the desks' stored stress results added (additive), with each desk's limit use and breach, once per business date (quick win Q4 of docs/architecture/COMPUTED_ATTRIBUTES.md, until the stress engine STR).

**Class** computed · **Key** `SCENARIO_ID` · **Dated by** `on request` · **Cadence** on change · **Stored by** connector `mr-derived` (plugin `derived`).

**Grain:** One record per SCENARIO_ID of the stress-result records, computed when asked. **Contract:** `contracts/stress-scenario-pnl.contract.yaml` ([full contract page](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/market-risk.md#sspnl-stress-pl-of-a-scenario-across-desks-derived-from-the-stress-results-stress-scenario-pnl)).

| Column | Type | Key | Presence | Unit | Example or values | Link | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SCENARIO_ID` | id | key | required |  |  |  | The value the stress-result records are grouped by ($.SCENARIO) |
| `RESULT_IDS` | id list |  | derived |  |  |  | The ids of the grouped stress-result records (at most 1000) |
| `DESK_COUNT` | integer |  | optional |  |  |  | Desks with a result under the scenario |
| `PNL` | amount |  | optional | USD |  |  | Sum of the desks' P&L under the scenario (a loss is negative) |
| `WORST_DESK_PNL` | amount |  | optional | USD |  |  | The most negative desk P&L |
| `SCENARIO_NAME` | text |  | optional |  |  |  | The scenario's name, as the results carry it |
| `LIMIT` | amount |  | optional | USD |  |  | Sum of the desks' limits (positive magnitudes, F5): context, not a bank limit |
| `DESKS` | record list |  | derived |  |  |  | One row per desk result, worst P&L first |
| `BREACHES` | integer |  | derived |  |  |  | Desks whose loss exceeds their limit (LIMIT_USE > 1) |
| `WORST_LIMIT_USE` | rate |  | derived | fraction |  |  | The largest desk limit use |
| `BY_DESK` | record list |  | derived |  |  |  | P&L by desk: rows {label, value, count} |

Nested `DESKS[]`:

| Column | Type | Key | Presence | Unit | Example or values | Link | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RESULT_ID` | id |  | optional |  |  |  | The desk's stress result |
| `DESK` | id |  | optional |  |  | `desk` | The desk |
| `PNL` | amount |  | optional | USD |  |  | Its P&L under the scenario |
| `LIMIT` | amount |  | optional | USD |  |  | Its stress limit, a positive magnitude |
| `LIMIT_USE` | rate |  | optional | fraction |  |  | max(-PNL, 0) / LIMIT; empty when there is no limit |
| `STATUS` | text |  | optional |  |  |  | BREACH when LIMIT_USE > 1, else OK |

**Links:** `DESKS[].DESK` → `desk`.

- Derived, never stored: the derived connector mr-derived over the stress results of the business date, shared by every reader.
- Additive by construction (a sum of desk P&L); the stress engine (STR.md) will compute it from per-trade scenario P&L in place.

## Data retrieval

Where each kind's data comes from, how it reaches the lake and how to check it. Three origins: **external** data, fetched from a public source by the pack's refresh script (each source, its licence and worked examples on the [External data](../../../../docs/guides/PUBLIC_DATA.md) help page); **synthetic** test data (or hand-written reference data), written by a generator with fictitious names; **computed** by a Drishti engine when it is asked, never stored by a source.

| Command | Kind | Origin | How it reaches Drishti |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SCN` | `stress-scenario` | synthetic: `python3 tools/testdata/make_testdata.py` (and `python3 tools/packgen/banking/make_data.py` for samples/) | `data/testdata/market-risk/stress-scenario/` → `lake demo` → connector `risk-store` |
| `STR` | `stress-result` | synthetic: `python3 tools/testdata/make_testdata.py` (and `python3 tools/packgen/banking/make_data.py` for samples/) | `data/testdata/market-risk/stress-result/` → `lake demo` → connector `risk-store` |
| `FRTB` | `frtb-sensitivity` | synthetic: `python3 tools/testdata/make_testdata.py` (and `python3 tools/packgen/banking/make_data.py` for samples/) | `data/testdata/market-risk/frtb-sensitivity/` → `lake demo` → connector `risk-store` |
| `PNL` | `pnl-explain` | synthetic: `python3 tools/testdata/make_testdata.py` (and `python3 tools/packgen/banking/make_data.py` for samples/) | `data/testdata/market-risk/pnl-explain/` → `lake demo` → connector `risk-store` |
| `TVAL` | `trade-valuation` | synthetic: `python3 tools/testdata/make_testdata.py` (and `python3 tools/packgen/banking/make_data.py` for samples/) | `data/testdata/market-risk/trade-valuation/` → `lake demo` → connector `risk-store` |
| `POS` | `position` | computed by Drishti: (the VaR engine derives positions from the trades of pnl-vector when a date loads, docs/guides/VAR_GUIDE.md section 15.6); see the [VaR guide](../../../../docs/guides/VAR_GUIDE.md) (positions) | nothing to load: computed from its inputs when asked |
| `PORT` | `portfolio` | synthetic: `python3 tools/packgen/var/make_var_data.py` | `data/testdata/market-risk/portfolio/` → `lake demo` → connector `risk-store` |
| `PNLV` | `pnl-vector` | synthetic: `python3 tools/packgen/var/make_var_data.py` | `data/testdata/market-risk/pnl-vector/` → `lake demo` → connector `risk-store` |
| `SPV` | `scenario-pv` | synthetic: `python3 tools/packgen/var/make_var_data.py` | `data/testdata/market-risk/scenario-pv/` → `lake demo` → connector `risk-store` |
| `FXS` | `fx-scenario` | synthetic: `python3 tools/packgen/var/make_var_data.py` | `data/testdata/market-risk/fx-scenario/` → `lake demo` → connector `risk-store` |
| `SSET` | `scenario-set` | synthetic: `python3 tools/packgen/var/make_var_data.py` | `data/testdata/market-risk/scenario-set/` → `lake demo` → connector `risk-store` |
| `HIER` | `risk-hierarchy` | synthetic: `python3 tools/packgen/var/make_var_data.py` | `data/testdata/market-risk/risk-hierarchy/` → `lake demo` → connector `risk-store` |
| `VLIM` | `var-limit` | synthetic: `python3 tools/testdata/make_testdata.py` (and `python3 tools/packgen/banking/make_data.py` for samples/) | `data/testdata/market-risk/var-limit/` → `lake demo` → connector `risk-store` |
| `VRES` | `var-result` | computed by Drishti: the reactive connector var-engine (java engine com.ash.drishti.server.var.VarResultEngine); see the [VaR guide](../../../../docs/guides/VAR_GUIDE.md) | nothing to load: computed from its inputs when asked |
| `VWIF` | `var-whatif` | computed by Drishti: the reactive connector var-whatif (python engine drishti_compute.var.whatif:VarWhatIfEngine, pool var); see the [VaR guide](../../../../docs/guides/VAR_GUIDE.md) | nothing to load: computed from its inputs when asked |
| `VOFF` | `var-official` | computed by Drishti: the official end-of-day capture (VarOfficial), appended by VarPublisher to risk-results/var-official; see the [VaR guide](../../../../docs/guides/VAR_GUIDE.md) (official results) | published by the server to `<data>/delta/risk-results/var-official/` |
| `SSPNL` | `stress-scenario-pnl` | computed by Drishti: the derived connector mr-derived over the kind stress-result | nothing to load: computed from its inputs when asked |

### Generators

| Generator | Writes | Check |
|---|---|---|
| `python3 tools/testdata/make_testdata.py` | sixty business days of every dataset of the seven packs into data/testdata/<pack>/<kind>/ (the universe: tools/testdata/universe.py; deterministic, fictitious names) | `python3 tools/testdata/make_testdata.py --check` |
| `python3 tools/packgen/banking/make_data.py` | the pack's few reference documents in samples/ (from the taxonomy, tools/packgen/banking/taxonomy.py) | `python3 tools/packgen/banking/make_data.py --check` |
| `python3 tools/packgen/var/make_var_data.py` | the VaR engine's inputs into data/testdata/market-risk/<kind>/, as an upstream risk batch would deliver them, from the committed trades (VAR_GUIDE.md) | `python3 -m pytest -q tools/packgen/var/test_var_data.py` |

### Into the lake, checking, offline

- **The lake.** `python3 tools/drishti.py lake demo` reads `data/testdata/testdata.yaml` and writes every dataset (test data, the packs' samples and the committed public-data snapshots) into `<data>/delta/<domain>/<kind>/`, where the pack's Delta connector serves it; a computed kind needs nothing loaded. `lake build` loads your own large JSON exports the same way ([Tools](../../../../docs/guides/TOOLS.md)).
- **Checking.** `python3 tools/contracts.py check` compares every contract with the pack and its data; each generator's `--check` (above) fails when the committed files differ from what it would write; in the console, `<MNEMONIC> <GO>` lists a kind and the pack's code opens its overview with the count of each kind.
- **Offline.** Everything committed works without a network: the test data, the samples and the public-data snapshots are in the repository and `lake demo` reads only them. A refresh script runs offline from its download cache (`--offline`); a connector that reaches the internet (news, yfinance, the public-data feeds) is off as shipped and never starts on a machine configured offline (`drishti.offline.plugins`).
